name: spec-kit
description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with SDD or any other process!
one_liner: A free toolkit that makes an AI coding assistant write a proper spec and plan before it starts coding, instead of guessing as it goes.
buyer: An engineering lead at a startup frustrated that AI-generated code keeps drifting from what was actually asked for.
business_use_cases: A dev-process consultancy bundles this into a paid 'AI-assisted spec-driven development' rollout for engineering teams adopting AI coding tools at scale.
A technical writer/PM hybrid freelancer offers to write the specs and templates GitHub's tool consumes, as a service for non-technical founders who can't write specs themselves.
A bootcamp or course creator uses it as the backbone of a paid 'how to actually manage an AI coding agent' class.

money_ideas.idea: Consulting engagement rolling out spec-driven AI development practices across a team, billed per engagement.
Ongoing retainer as the 'spec writer' who turns a non-technical founder's ideas into specs this toolkit can execute.

steal_this: It's a free process tool from GitHub — the real money is in being the human who writes great specs for founders who can't, charged by the project.
